basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 5703, where the Water and Downtown Skyline are yours! This rarely available, penthouse level, unit at premier One Rincon Hill proudly displays immersive & unobstructed water and city sunset views from the living areas and western views from the balcony - all from the best vantage point in the building through floor-to-ceiling windows. The kitchen features Studio Becker cabinetry & stainless-steel appliances including Sub-Zero refrigerator. One car valet parking and an additional storage cage complete this home. One Rincon Hill is a world-class building w/ a proven track record of spoiling residents with w/5-star hotel-quality amenities, including 24/7 valet full-sized parking, a grand porte-cochere, 24/7 concierge, package & dry cleaning attendants, a heated lap pool, hot tub, 2 club-level gyms w/locker rooms, zoom-friendly lounges, secured designated storage, a doggy relief area, & Uncle Harry's Resident Lounge.
